cells.scene: Several newly printed books and magazines lie in a neat stack beside a printing press, published material with blank covers.
A newly married adult couple stands smiling together, one holding a small bouquet, wedding rings visible and simple celebratory clothing.

An adult enjoys free time reading in a garden chair after setting aside work papers, relaxed posture and cup of tea.
